title: Sweet Lassi
description: A thick, chilled Punjabi yoghurt drink sweetened with sugar and scented with cardamom and rose water.
steps: Put the curd, sugar and cold water in a blender.
Blend for 1 minute until frothy and the sugar has dissolved.
Add the cardamom powder and rose water and pulse once.
Pour into tall glasses and top with the chopped almonds; serve cold.
